description: 서울시설공단_도시고속도로 도로위치인식표지 현황_GW [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울시설공단. 본 자료는 도시고속도로 가로등주에 부여된 고유 식별 번호와 해당 시설물의 정밀한 위치 데이터를 결합하여 구축한 위치 정보 통계셋입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울시설공단. Its tags are 도시고속도록, 위치정보, 가로등, 도로위치인식표지, 서울시설공단. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
